sources.title: Recap: Tennessee escapes Arkansas 24-17
sources.description: Well, a win is a win, even if it’s an ugly one, and under the circumstances, Josh Heupel and the Tennessee Volunteers will take it. Tennessee scored late in the fourth quarter to go up 24-17, and they hung on in the final few minutes to get out of Fayetteville with a rare win. It […]
